decisions.D1: A draft row is inserted with geographic_geometry (never geometry) by writeDraftFeature (packages/server/src/modules/areas/areas.ts:334, called at :1012). A redraft of a row still at revision 0 moves the outline to the newer package's (UPDATE ... WHERE revision=0); a recorded row is never touched. No code path changes a draft's outline after drafting: createPackageCorrection rebuilds from recorded rows (revision>0) and answerQuestion changes heights only, so 'again on a package correction' is the redraft update.
decisions.D2: No recorded geometry until recorded: every reader of the stored outline filters revision>0 (list below, pinned by draft-outline.test.ts).
decisions.D3: The proposal rule (areaProposals) is unchanged. A window read gives it, from every package, only the features whose draft outline meets the window (GiST on geographic_geometry) plus every feature whose row holds no draft outline (recorded corrections, drafts written before this change). Every package names a feature by the one id its (namespace, sourceKey) link gives, so filtering by id leaves the rule's answer for the kept features unchanged; rejections are package fields and are kept whole.
decisions.D4: The window and single-feature reads take every package of the area (no LIMIT 30); budget 15,000 and paging 4,000 unchanged. The whole-area context read (full bodies, AREA_DISPLAY_LIMIT 10,000) keeps its newest-30 cut.
decisions.D5: Old drafts (geographic_geometry NULL) stay on the body path: kept by the rule filter and placed from the package body by coalesce in the proposed CTE. Mixed window tested.

behaviourNotes: A window that draws no feature of a package no longer checks that package's cited sources, so a quarantined package with an unavailable source refuses only the windows that would draw from it (the summary still checks every package).
